name: A/B Experiment on Single-Page Checkout Conversion
task_description: Design and execute an A/B growth experiment testing a single-page checkout variant against multi-step checkout, defining telemetry tracking schemas and statistical evaluation criteria.

guardrails.enforce_first_principles_hypothesis: Declare explicit null hypothesis, primary metric, and minimum sample size before code changes
guardrails.prohibit_speculative_variants: Adhere to YAGNI: implement only the minimal variant needed to test the core hypothesis
guardrails.enforce_fail_safe_flags: Feature flags must fail-open to default control flow without impacting user checkout
guardrails.enforce_compound_learning_loop: Synthesize statistical findings and telemetry behavior into repository experimentation memory

invariants: Experiment must declare explicit null hypothesis and primary metric prior to code edits
Telemetry event names and schemas must adhere to canonical tracking format
Feature flag must fail-open to default control flow in case of configuration errors
Document variant learnings and post-experiment cleanup tasks in completion report Section 5
